hooks.command: output=$(dotnet build --no-restore 2>&1); rc=$?; [ $rc -ne 0 ] && { echo "Build failed after last changes:"; echo "$output" | grep -E " error " | head -15; exit 2; }

arch_dir=$(find tests -maxdepth 1 -type d -iname '*architecture*' 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$arch_dir" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"No architecture test project found under tests/ (name must contain Architecture)."}}'; exit 1; fi; output=$(dotnet test "$arch_dir" --no-restore 2>&1); rc=$?; [ $rc -ne 0 ] && { echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Architecture tests failed. Fix violations before committing."}}'; exit 1; }
